title: Lost Tales
description: A Datapack that adds overworld exploration and new items for combat. This datapack is designed to be used on servers, however it can be used in solo play.
body: Lost Tales is a Datapack created solely by PEARLLOBBER. It adds a diverse story and lore to minecraft and was inspired by Incendium. It gets frequent updates and its complexity gets more toned overtime. Starting from simple custom weapons, I plan to add custom bosses.
